rules.justification: Elastic family (elastic incl. plane stress and finite deformation, elastic_thermal, elastic_orthotropic, elastic_anisotropic): the port replicates the upstream operation order (D-008: Eigen-order small dense ops, Eigen's gebp order for products), so stresses, tangents, energies, internals, celerity and wave speeds are bit-identical in upstream-compat mode.
rules.evidence: Measured: 16,980 / 16,980 compat values (30 cases) and 11,560 / 11,560 corrected-default values bit-identical, debug and release (material_fixtures.rs; docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md).
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026

rules.justification: Upstream-compat replay (LawOptions::upstream()) of the inelastic laws: the replay feeds the probe's own input, the FE gradient of u = H X recomputed with akantu_fe (bit-identical to the oracle), and compares the gradient stored by the law after the step (plastic_mazars: (grad_u - eps_p) + eps_p) and every output bitwise; the kernels replicate upstream's operation order (D-008: Eigen-order small dense ops incl. the allocation-free compile-time 3x3 EigenSolver of Mazars, glibc exp/pow/log/sincos ports of akantu_core::glibc_libm, C++ std::max/min semantics). Valid for the recorded corpus (strict aarch64 oracle, fixtures regenerated with the lifetime-corrected probe) on the platforms measured (macOS arm64; the libm calls are platform-independent ports). The corrected defaults are not compared with these fixtures except where they provably coincide (inelastic_material_fixtures.rs); the Neo-Hookean corrected-root C33 comparison is a separate kernel-test bound (1e-5/mu, valid for lambda >= 0, mu > 0), not a fixture rule. Laws: marigo (16 cases).
rules.evidence: Measured (debug and release, macOS arm64): marigo_material_points_match_oracle_bitwise: 12,560 / 12,560 values bit-identical (NUMERICAL_VALIDATION, inelastic materials, results).
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
